prompt: I want you to act as a note-taking assistant for a lecture. Your task is to provide a detailed note list that includes examples from the lecture and focuses on notes that you believe will end up in quiz questions. Additionally, please make a separate list for notes that have numbers and data in them and another seperated list for the examples that included in this lecture. The notes should be concise and easy to read.
improvedPrompt:
Improved prompt:

I require your assistance in capturing detailed notes from a university lecture. Your primary objective is to generate a comprehensive note list that reflects the key concepts discussed during the lecture.

Please ensure your notes are:
- Thoroughly detailed, capturing the essence of each major idea
- Focused on the most exam-worthy topics, as you would identify them
- Organized into three distinct lists:
  a. A main notes list that summarizes the core lecture content
  b. A separate list that highlights any numerical data, formulas, or statistical information presented
  c. An example list that catalogs all the real-world examples and case studies mentioned
- Written in a clear, concise, and easy-to-read format
- Free from any unnecessary details or tangential information
- Organized with a consistent hierarchy and structure for quick reference

Please demonstrate your understanding of the lecture material by:
- Identifying the main themes and subtopics
- Recognizing the significance of each point
- Differentiating between foundational concepts and more peripheral details
- Anticipating the types of questions that would likely appear on a subsequent quiz for this lecture

Your notes should enable a student to effectively review and study for an upcoming exam or assignment. They should provide a comprehensive yet streamlined summary of the lecture content.
